jobs.description_text: FireMon delivers Network Security Policy Control for the Modern Enterprise. Most enterprises run firewalls from multiple vendors alongside cloud security groups and microsegmentation platforms, and no single console can say whether it all works together. We believe policy is the control plane for network security: it defines what the environment should do, and the infrastructure carries it out. FireMon gives security teams one place to see, govern, and prove that their policy is doing what they intend, across on-prem, cloud, and hybrid environments. As a Solutions Architect, you'll play a valuable role within the FireMon Customer Experience team, helping to assess business opportunities and support the development of strategies to address technical challenges. In this role, you'll work closely with security architects, infrastructure specialists, and engineering teams within customer organizations, gaining hands-on experience designing effective, results-driven solutions. You will support both Pre-Sale (Buyer's Journey) and Post-Sale (Customer Journey) phases, building your technical expertise and product knowledge along the way. With guidance from senior team members, you'll help empower customers to make informed decisions and achieve success in their projects.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Marketing
jobs.description_text: Role Summary Lexeo’s Commercial team is building the strategy, insights, brand and infrastructure required to bring LX2006 to patients – marking Lexeo’s transition from a clinical-stage to a commercial company. We are seeking an Associate Director, Marketing to play a central role in preparing for the launch of LX2006, Lexeo’s first commercial product, anticipated in the US in 2028 and globally thereafter. Reporting to the Senior Director, Marketing, this individual will serve as the LX2006 brand lead, owning critical launch workstreams end to end – from customer insights and competitive intelligence to market development, campaigns, customer targeting and launch readiness – and working closely with cross-functional partners in Market Access/HEOR, Medical Affairs, Patient Affairs, Clinical Development, Regulatory, Legal, CMC, and Business Development (ad hoc) as part of Lexeo’s Launch Readiness Team. The role will also support early commercial planning for LX2020, Lexeo’s gene therapy candidate for PKP2-associated arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy. This is a highly visible, hands-on opportunity to build a launch from the ground up and help shape the commercial foundation of a growing clinical stage company. We welcome applications from candidates located across the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic. Compensation is dependent on qualifications and experience

jobs.title: 3D Computer Vision Researcher – Arlington, VA
jobs.description_text: Advance 3D Vision Research from Algorithms to Open Source Applications. In this position, you’ll research and develop algorithms for photogrammetry, camera calibration, registration, and 3D reconstruction from images and video. Current projects emphasize aerial and satellite imagery, with opportunities to adapt these capabilities to new challenges and data domains such as underwater imagery and synthetic aperture radar. Your work will contribute to open source applications and frameworks including TeleSculptor, KWIVER, and Danesfield. You’ll also explore how 3D vision can support broader computer vision problems such as object detection and tracking, change detection, super resolution, and video compression. Kitware partners with government R&D agencies, branches of the U.S. military, members of the Intelligence Community, and commercial organizations ranging from startups to Fortune 500 companies. You’ll have opportunities to collaborate directly with customers, participate in field tests and demonstrations, publish novel work, and apply state-of-the-art artificial intelligence approaches to real-world national security challenges.

You'll work directly with engineers and researchers to identify opportunities, shape what gets built, and turn real-world problems into funded, high-impact technical work. That might mean shaping an AI-driven medical imaging platform, a large-scale scientific data system, or a geospatial analytics capability that doesn’t exist yet. Kitware advances science and makes the world a better place through open-source software. We collaborate with top universities, national laboratories, government agencies, and commercial technology leaders to develop both cutting-edge research prototypes and production systems with outsized real-world impact. Our tools are used by millions, including CMake, a widely used tool in C++ development. We're a 100% employee-owned company (ESOP) with no outside investors and about 200 employees. Our leadership has a technical background, and there's no middle management layer between you and the problems you're solving. We're not chasing VC rounds or seeking an exit. jobs.title: Marketing & Communications Manager
jobs.description_text: Join the Future of Robotic Biomanufacturing! Multiply Labs is a robotics company on a mission to solve a significant bottleneck in modern medicine: the manufacturing of life-saving advanced biologics, from gene and cell therapies to antibodies and more. Today, these therapies are produced through manual, labor-intensive processes. Costs are extremely high—often $500K–$2M per patient—limiting access to only a small fraction of those who need them. As product complexity increases and the cost of failure and scientific labor rises, the industry is shifting toward automation. Robotics and AI are making automated biologics manufacturing feasible, reliable, and economically scalable. We believe the future of biomanufacturing is robotic—closed, automated, and scalable—ensuring critical therapeutics are accessible to every patient who needs them. Why This Matters We don’t just build robots—we’re building the essential infrastructure for next generation biologics. Our technology enables biopharma companies to scale production without redesigning their science, reducing regulatory hurdles and lowering costs so these treatments can reach more patients. The Stack & The Scale The Mission: Build the world’s best robots to make life-saving therapies accessible to all. The Technology: Advanced robotic orchestration, high-precision automation, cloud-integrated hardware-software systems, dextrous manipulation, and imitation learning. jobs.title: AI Trainer - Tier I
jobs.description_text: NextGen is seeking a knowledgeable and engaging Tier I Artificial Intelligence (AI) Instructor to support foundational AI and Machine Learning (ML) training and workforce upskilling initiatives for military and government personnel. In this role, you will deliver instructor-led training designed to introduce participants to foundational AI concepts, generative AI applications, and practical techniques for integrating AI into everyday workflows. Your work will help personnel to develop the knowledge, confidence, and skills necessary to effectively and responsibly use approved AI-enabled tools. The ideal candidate will have experience in technical instruction, adult education, military training, and/or workforce development along with hands-on experience using generative AI applications. This role requires collaboration with technical personnel, training coordinators, functional subject matter experts (SMEs), and government stakeholders to deliver effective instruction and support continuous improvement of training materials

This role requires collaboration with technical personnel, training coordinators, functional subject matter experts (SMEs), and government stakeholders to deliver effective instruction and support continuous improvement of training materials.

jobs.title: Account Executive - Commercial, Spotify Technology
jobs.description_text: Spotify Technology is our business-to-business software team, helping organizations improve how they build and deliver software. Our products, including Backstage Portal, Confidence, and Xirp, support developers and AI-powered systems as they navigate increasingly complex engineering environments. As an Account Executive on our Commercial team, you will drive new business for Spotify Technology. You'll focus on companies with fewer than 1,000 employees, where sales cycles typically run from weeks to a few months and success depends on a repeatable, scalable sales motion. You'll manage a high volume of opportunities, work with one or a small group of decision-makers (often a hands-on engineering leader or CTO), and move deals efficiently from the first conversation to close. You'll also help shape the playbook that enables our commercial business to grow. You'll collaborate with Sales Engineering, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to create a seamless customer experience. Your ability to quickly understand customers' technical needs and connect them to clear business value will be key to your success.

jobs.title: Analyst, Royalty Operations
jobs.description_text: Royalty Operations owns the operations behind Spotify’s royalty process across music, audiobooks, lyrics, and creator content. We implement content licenses in Spotify’s proprietary royalty systems, calculate and report royalties to our rightsholder partners, provide analytics to Accounting stakeholders, and serve as the go-to team for royalty questions across the company. As our business grows more complex, we’re focused on staying accurate and on time while getting faster and more flexible through scripting, Gen AI, and agentic workflows.

jobs.title: Artist & Label Partnerships Manager - GSA (15-month fixed-term)
jobs.description_text: We have a great opportunity for an Artist & Label Partnerships Manager to come and join the band in Berlin. The Artist & Label Partnerships team is the face of Spotify to artists, managers, labels & distributors. As an Artist & Label Partnerships Manager your mission is to ensure that key artists, managers, and labels see Spotify as the #1 partner for artist development and monetization. In this role you will work with a set of core label partners and artists. This role has a strong focus on launching innovative partnerships and initiatives and you will drive activations that enable, educate, and unlock new opportunities for our partners and Spotify. We seek a highly motivated partner manager based in Berlin with a strong partnerships, music marketing and music / entertainment / media background. This individual must be able to prioritize, multi-task, and influence in a fast paced environment. This role is on a 15-month fixed-term contract.

jobs.title: Associate Artist Label Partnerships Manager, South Korea
jobs.description_text: Spotify’s Artist & Label Partnerships (ALP) team works with artists, managers, record labels and distributors to help artists grow their audiences and connect with fans. As an Associate Artist & Label Partnerships Manager on the Korea Music team, you’ll manage relationships with selected partners and lead campaigns that help Korean artists reach more listeners at home and around the world. You’ll work with artist and label teams to understand their goals and turn them into opportunities for fans to discover and engage with their music.

jobs.title: Audiobook Licensing & Partnerships Manager - Japan
jobs.description_text: At Spotify, we are redefining the audiobook industry with our innovative Audiobooks in Premium model. Our mission is to empower creators and consumers by delivering the best audiobook content with unmatched quality and accessibility. We are building a thriving ecosystem that scales with creativity, collaboration, and innovative technology. We’re building Spotify’s audiobook business in Japan and looking for someone to lead our relationships with Japanese publishers. You’ll help build our publisher portfolio and secure a catalogue that resonates with listeners in Japan. After launch, you’ll keep owning and growing these partnerships so they deliver lasting value for Spotify and our publishing partners.

jobs.title: Client Partner - Emerging & Scaled (French Speaking)
jobs.description_text: Sell what you love. For us and millions of users across the globe, that’s Spotify. Join the Sales team and you’ll build the relationships that help grow our business in existing markets and beyond. We don’t just sell creative solutions to our clients and partners, we help to shape them; using our expert knowledge of ad products, sales channels and the industry to impact the way the world experiences music and podcasts. We are looking for an exceptional Client Partner to join our Emerging & Scaled team, one of the fastest-growing units within Spotify’s Ad Sales organization. This role is perfect for someone who wakes up every morning excited to connect with clients and inspire them with the power of Spotify. You bring curiosity, resilience, and a collaborative mindset, along with a passion for building meaningful client partnerships. Integrity and a healthy work-life balance are non-negotiable. You’ll shape how Spotify advertisers reach audiences and elevate their connection to our platform.

jobs.title: Client Partner ANZ
jobs.description_text: Sell what you love. For us and millions of users across the globe, that’s Spotify. Join the Sales team and you’ll build the relationships that help grow our business in existing markets and beyond. We don’t just sell creative solutions to our clients and partners, we help to shape them; using our expert knowledge of ad products, sales channels and the industry to impact the way the world experiences music and podcasts. Spotify is seeking a talented and dynamic individual to join the team as a Contractor - Client Partner based in Sydney. This role will be responsible for driving revenue growth and building long-term relationships with key advertising clients and agencies. You will collaborate closely with internal stakeholders across sales, marketing, and product teams to deliver innovative advertising solutions that meet the needs of our clients while maximising revenue opportunities for Spotify. Please note this is a fixed-term, 12 months, contractor role hired through a third party.

jobs.title: Demand Generation & Campaign Operations Manager
jobs.description_text: The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers. You run our websites, search, webinars and email across the Spotify Technology portfolio. Your job is to bring people into the funnel and move them through it: from finding us in search or at a webinar, to signing up, to becoming an active user, to a meeting with sales. You also own the numbers. Every week you tell the team what’s working, what isn’t and what we’re changing. You work AI-first, you know our martech stack inside out, and you use the newest features of both.

jobs.title: Editor, UK & Ireland
jobs.description_text: The Music Mission team owns Spotify’s end to end proposition for music creators and the experiences they create for fans. The team is dedicated to building tools and services to enable creation, promotion, expression, and monetization at scale. Editorial UK & Ireland sits at the heart of the listener experience on Spotify. We reflect culture and drive artist discovery through playlists, storytelling formats, and tools, with a focus on new music. As our Pop Editor, you’ll bring deep cultural expertise and a data-informed approach to shape how millions of people discover music across playlists, video, and other parts of the app.

jobs.title: Growth Lead - Japan
jobs.description_text: Join Spotify's Japan Growth team and help more listeners discover the value of Spotify Premium. As part of our Markets & Subscriptions organisation, you'll play a key role in growing our subscriber base in one of Spotify's most important markets. Japan is Spotify's only single-country region, and we're entering an exciting new chapter focused on partnerships and sustainable growth. Working across marketing, product, data and commercial teams, you'll shape our growth strategy, turn customer insights into action and find new ways to connect Japanese listeners with Spotify Premium. You'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact while developing your leadership responsibilities over time.

jobs.title: Head of Markets Strategy & Operations, Japan
jobs.description_text: The Markets team is responsible for managing Spotify’s regions and their performance across all business-relevant metrics. Our team consists of regional Managing Directors and Market Strategy & Operation Managers (MSO). We are looking for a strategic, analytically-driven and open-minded character to support our efforts in Japan. As Head of Market Strategy and Operations, you will be responsible for strategic direction based on business analysis and insights; business planning; regional operating processes; and managing cross-functional projects by building strong relationships across the company. In this position, you will work closely with global stakeholder, local functional leadership and report to the Managing Director, Japan

jobs.title: Manager, International Audiobook Licensing & Partnerships
jobs.description_text: At Spotify, we’re building a thriving audiobook ecosystem that connects authors and publishers with listeners around the world. As our audiobook business expands into new markets, we’re looking for someone to grow our international publisher portfolio. You’ll build relationships with publishers of all sizes, help them bring their catalogues to Spotify, and shape scalable ways to onboard and support them. Your goal is to make Spotify a trusted home for publishers audiobooks, combining a welcoming partner experience with sustainable commercial growth.

jobs.title: Retention & Engagement Marketing Lead
jobs.description_text: At Spotify, our mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by connecting creators with fans and helping listeners discover the audio they love. As we continue to grow in India, building lasting relationships with our listeners is central to our success. Our Marketing team plays a key role in shaping how people discover, experience and stay connected to Spotify. We're looking for a Retention & Engagement Marketing Lead to develop strategies that deepen listener engagement, reduce churn and bring inactive users back. You'll combine consumer insights, data and creativity to build experiences that give listeners more reasons to return to Spotify.

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Manager - Spotify Technology
jobs.description_text: Spotify Technology is our business-to-business software team, helping organizations improve how they build and deliver software. Our products, including Backstage Portal, Confidence, and Xirp, support developers and AI-powered systems as they navigate increasingly complex engineering environments. As Revenue Operations Manager, you'll own revenue operations for Spotify Technology, helping our sales organization scale from early growth to a mature, segmented go-to-market model. This is a hands-on role where you'll work closely with the business day to day, identify challenges early, and build the systems, processes, and insights that enable sustainable growth. You'll partner with Sales leadership, Marketing, Sales Engineering, and Customer Success to improve how we operate across the customer lifecycle. You'll balance strategic planning with practical execution, creating structure that helps our teams work efficiently as the business evolves.

jobs.title: Senior Accountant, General Ledger Accounting
jobs.description_text: We are looking for a Senior Accountant to join our Global Record to Report (RTR) team. Our close is evolving fast, and we’re looking for someone who combines strong accounting judgment with curiosity about how AI and automation can change how we work, and who wants to help build that future rather than wait for it. As a Senior Accountant on the General Ledger team, you will own key close processes end to end, from preparation and analysis to explaining results to partners across Finance. You will use data and AI tools to remove manual work, spend more of your time on review and insight, and help shape how a lean, global team scales.

jobs.title: Social Marketing Manager, Australia & New Zealand
jobs.description_text: Spotify is looking for a Social Marketing Manager with deep understanding, endless curiosity, and proven ability to shape culture through social media activity. This person will run the always-on social presence for Spotify in Australia and New Zealand across TikTok and Meta accounts. You’ll bring a strong understanding of youth culture, brand tone and what commands attention, an enthusiasm to keep trying new things, and the ability to make informed decisions at pace. You’ll shape what Spotify looks, sounds and feels like in the feed, across everything from Premium, product, music and culture moments to creating content with the artists, podcasters and authors our listeners love and have yet to discover. You’ll manage key external relationships with our social, influencer and video production agencies, and work closely with artists, talent and teams across Spotify locally and globally – turning strategy into content people watch, remember and want to share.

jobs.title: Studio & Project Manager
jobs.description_text: The Music Mission team owns Spotify's end to end proposition for music creators and the experiences they create for fans. The team is dedicated to building tools and services to enable creation, promotion, expression, and monetization at scale. The Artist & Label Partnerships team (ALP) is the face of Spotify to artists, managers, labels and distributors across Sweden. We're looking for a Studio & Project Manager to make our Stockholm studio a place where artists, labels and fans connect, turning the stories behind artists and releases into sessions, video and formats that reach the next generation of listeners. You'll lead the studio and its projects with support from the wider ALP team, and project manage selected ALP initiatives so key partners see Spotify as their number one partner.

jobs.title: Tax Manager - Transfer Pricing [Analytics, Models & AI]
jobs.description_text: We’re looking for a Tax Manager to join Spotify’s Global Transfer Pricing team, reporting to the Director of Global Transfer Pricing. In this role you’ll focus on analytics, modelling and AI. You’ll drive the development of Spotify’s global transfer pricing models and economic analyses, keeping our intercompany pricing accurate, efficient and defensible in every jurisdiction where we operate. You’ll also help lead the team’s use of AI tools and automation to change how transfer pricing work gets done, from forecasting and projections to audit support. You’ll join a team of skilled, dedicated colleagues in a fast-moving international company, with plenty of room to take on responsibility. Above all, your work will impact the way the world experiences audio.

At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

The Bid Coordinator is the organizational backbone of the bid team. Working alongside Bid Managers and Bid Specialists, this role makes sure every bid runs to a rigorous, well-managed process, so that deadlines are met, contributors know what is expected of them, and nothing falls through the cracks. This is a process and project coordination role rather than a content or strategy role. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive: someone who enjoys building order out of complexity, keeps many moving parts on track at once, and is comfortable following up with colleagues across the business to keep work moving. It is a strong entry point for someone looking to grow a career in bid management.

Responsibilities: 

  • Bid Planning and Scheduling Support
    • Support Bid Managers in building bid plans that work backward from the submission date, including milestones, review gates, internal deadlines, and buffer time. 
    • Set up and maintain bid trackers, schedules, and responsibility matrices (e.g., RACI) for each pursuit.
    • Keep plans up to date as timelines shift, and flag schedule risks to the Bid Manager early.
  • Tracking, Follow-Up, and Accountability

At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

This position will report to the Senior Director, Associate General Counsel, IP. Beyond the legal chops, we're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys building relationships — you'll spend as much time with engineers and researchers as you will with lawyers, so a warm, curious, low-ego style goes a long way here. We value people who can make patent law feel approachable rather than intimidating, who bring a sense of humor to a fast-moving environment, and who are as excited about celebrating an inventor's first disclosure as they are about closing out a tricky filing decision. This is a great opportunity for someone to come in and manage the patent function at Lyft, working on cutting-edge issues spanning Lyft's global expansion, Lyft Urban Solutions' mobility hardware and software business, and supporting the deployment and expansion of autonomous vehicles on Lyft's network.

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Manager, Lifecycle
jobs.description_text:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. To do this, we start with our own community by creating an open, inclusive, and diverse organization.

The Lifecycle Growth Marketing team engages with millions of Lyft riders and drivers to drive preference and usage of Lyft. The team runs hundreds of acquisition, engagement, retention and resurrection experiments every year across email, push notifications, SMS and in-app messaging surfaces. 

We are data-driven in everything we do. We test and measure all of our communications and tailor experiences to be personalized and contextual by audience segment. 

In this role, you will work closely with Product, Engineering, Analytics, Data Science, and Marketing Operations to design, test and optimize incentive and non-incentive messages and experiences. 

Responsibilities:

  • Own the lifecycle marketing strategy for your audience — define the channel mix, set the prioritization framework, and ensure every communication delivers clear value to the target user
  • Build and manage an experimentation program that drives measurable impact — from ideation through results, with a clear point of view on what to test 
  • Partner with Engineering, Product, and Data Science to unlock new platform capabilities, influence roadmaps, and push beyond out-of-the-box tooling
  • Own performance reporting — define metrics, experimentation setup, and share results and next steps

jobs.description_text:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive. 

Lyft is looking for a talented, tech-savvy tax accountant to join our growing Tax Team. As a Senior Tax Analyst, you will report to the Tax Manager and take full ownership of indirect tax accounting, compliance, audit work streams, and from time to time ad hoc projects, delivering actionable insights and recommendations that influence business decisions. You will build trusted relationships across Engineering, Business Operations, Regulatory Compliance, and Accounting/Finance, and serve as a resource and mentor to junior members of the tax team.

Responsibilities:

  • Tax Technical & Accounting Expertise
    • Ensure accurate application of indirect tax and regulatory laws across assigned areas, reviewing complex tax returns and overseeing the compliance process end-to-end
    • Review tax and accounting records for quality and accuracy, identifying and correcting issues before they escalate
    • Lead preparation of workpapers and audit defense arguments for indirect tax audits, gathering transaction details and developing well-supported positions for submission to tax authorities
    • Train and mentor team members cross-functionally on indirect tax laws, regulatory requirements, and best practices within their area

jobs.description_text: Optimisation de l’implantation de l’offre de soins en zones rurales Organisme d’accueil : Centre de Génie Industriel (CGI) – IMT Mines Albi Le Centre de Génie Industriel (CGI) développe des activités d’enseignement et de recherche autour de la modélisation, du pilotage et de l’amélioration des systèmes industriels et organisationnels, dans des contextes complexes et incertains (industrie du futur, supply chain, résilience, etc.). Contexte et missions Les inégalités territoriales d’accès aux soins constituent un enjeu majeur des politiques publiques de santé en France. Elles sont particulièrement marquées dans les territoires ruraux et isolés, caractérisés par une faible densité de population, des distances importantes aux services de santé et une démographie médicale parfois fragile. Dans ces territoires, l’amélioration de l’accès aux soins ne repose pas uniquement sur l’augmentation du nombre de professionnels de santé, mais également sur leur localisation et leur organisation territoriale. Dans le cadre du projet de recherche MAillage Territorial pour Améliorer l’Accès aux soins dans les zones Rurales et Isolées (MATAARI), l’objectif est de développer des méthodes d’optimisation permettant de concevoir de nouvelles organisations territoriales de l’offre de soins, en tenant compte des contraintes géographiques, démographiques et médicales. jobs.description_text: WHY this position is important Pennylane builds the financial management and accounting platform used by SMEs and accounting firms in France, Germany and Spain. As a product-led company, we invest first in the product, and AI is now at the core of it. The ML & AI team (about thirty people in Paris, part of the Data organisation) builds the AI inside the product. Its first priority is Autopilot : automated accounting production with the accountant in control. Autopilot reads documents, books entries, matches bank transactions, reviews client files and prepares VAT returns with as little human intervention as possible. These tasks raise real ML problems. Answers must be exact, every client is different, accounting constraints can be checked automatically, and we have millions of real examples corrected by accountants. This internship is a chance to work on one of these problems with real data, real users and a direct path to production.
